purpose: G1's first code package cannot install its first dependency: RFC-2026-001 and CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md withhold every dependency until an approved RFC names it, the register's OPEN-018 forbids a lockfile until the application stack is announced, and RFC-2026-011 left the application tier's language to be decided with the stack at G1. On 2026-10-08 the Owner accepted A0's G1/G2 plan recommendations (D1-D6, D9, D11, D12). This package writes them down as RFC-2026-029: the language and its checking, the framework, hosting, environments, sign-in, the data path, jobs, status updates and error tracking, plus the exact dependency allowlist, the policy for adding a dependency, the lockfile and install policy, the repository layout, and the rule for what stays a spike until its contracts are Frozen v1.

amends_without_owning.rationale: A new decision record cannot land without these four, and each change is one line of registration, as RFC-2026-018 (8701555f) and RFC-2026-028 (1da0b1c3) did. test-kits/repository-json.test.mjs: RFC-2026-029-application-tier-stack.md appended to DECISION_RECORDS, which names every file under architecture/decisions so an undeclared RFC fails. scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs: the RFC appended to DIGESTED_FLOOR, so its digest cannot be dropped from the manifest. test-kits/branch-identity.test.mjs: this package's branch added to BRANCH_OWNERSHIP, which pins the whole branch-to-package mapping. test-kits/integrity-manifest.json: regenerated by npm run regenerate:manifest for the new digest and the three changed files. No rule, threshold or assertion changes in any of them. evidence/VERIFICATION.md is not amended: the change adds no test, so the recorded counts are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: The RFC states the application tier's language and that a type error fails CI through tsc --noEmit, with the compiler flags named, and keeps the tooling tier JavaScript ESM on the standard library with npm run check dependency-free (RFC-2026-011).
It names every allowed direct dependency exactly, split into runtime and development, with the decision each serves and where it may be imported, and names the refused alternatives.

It states the policy for adding a dependency so that no direct dependency arrives without an approved RFC (RFC-2026-001, CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md), and separates version changes of an allowlisted name from new dependencies.

It states the lockfile and install policy: one npm 11.19.0 lockfile, exact versions, registry-only resolution with integrity, npm ci --ignore-scripts, and how a lockfile change is reviewed; and it does not contradict the existing exit-90 guard on .npmrc.
It keeps Node 24.20.0 and npm 11.19.0 exactly as pinned.
It refuses the service-role key on the request and worker paths, puts the request path on the user's JWT with command functions, and the worker on RFC-2026-028's login role.

It fixes the layout: apps/web, a separate apps/worker deployment holding the worker credential and the dispatcher (RFC-2026-028 §3.3/2), src/modules/<key> per the register's MOD registry keys, db/foundation/migrations as the single migration source with no supabase/migrations.
It states what stays a spike, rung by rung of the register's freeze levels (sprint-0a-decision-register-contract-catalog-th.md:186-191), lowering none of them, package by package.
It names what a build must check once code exists, and says that until then the RFC is held by review alone.
It installs nothing and changes no CI, configuration, lockfile, migration or application path.
